validation_notes: Processed 14 unique CSV people from 15 SPBE rows; Roman Goryunov appeared twice and was consolidated with both CSV roles. Checked 2 local documents. Research rounds: 1 for each processed person. Major 2024 conflict: CSV/MarketScreener list Roman Goryunov and an old board roster, while 2024 sources identify Evgeny Serdyukov as CEO and indicate governance changed after January 2024 shareholder decisions. Weak sources used: MarketScreener for many biographies, because official SPB Exchange biographies were not available/opened and the local annual report text extraction did not expose named biographies. No patents, h-index, or confirmed scientific-publication profiles were found for the target people. QUALITY-PASS ROUND (2026-08-01, see research_notes/SPBE/quality_pass_round1_20260801.md): Step 0 git-HEAD check found the on-disk file already structurally identical to git HEAD (no regression to restore for this ticker). Simple omissions fixed: filled 15 previously-null professional_experience GICS triples for the company's own ПАО "СПБ Биржа" role across all 15 people (self-evident from this file's own top-level sector fields); Doctoral degree and MBA qualification_degree values filled from already-cited source wording (Tarabtsev, Berthelot). Genuine inconsistencies investigated and resolved with fresh, directly-fetched sources (not just picking a side): Aleksey Skorodumov's CSV-vs-MarketScreener board-membership conflict resolved in favor of the CSV via an independently-fetched Letopis biography plus an audit-it.ru registry record; Ivan Tyryshkin's 'current 2024 status uncertain' framing corrected to a dated fact (chairman only 16.03.2022-29.06.2022, left the board that date, per Letopis+TAdviser). GICS label corrections: Novorossiysk Commercial Sea Port (Marine Transportation to Transportation Infrastructure -- it is a port/terminal operator, not a vessel operator), BrokerCreditService (Consumer Finance to Capital Markets -- confirmed non-bank brokerage, not consumer lending), and three previously-bundled multi-company professional_experience entries were split so each company keeps its own correct label: ITinvest/Troyka Dialog corrected from Banks to Capital Markets while CentroCredit correctly stays Banks (Megredichyan); TCS Group Holding corrected from Capital Markets to Banks while Moscow Exchange correctly stays Capital Markets (Megredichyan); EL5-Energo corrected from Metals & Mining to Utilities/Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers while GV Gold and En+ Group correctly stay Metals & Mining (Chmel). Honest-gap follow-ups resolved with new sources: Oleg Mikhasenko's and Aleksey Skorodumov's education (previously fully unconfirmed) were found and directly verified (Kommersant; Letopis+audit-it.ru); Jacques der Megredichyan's education (previously fully unconfirmed) was found via his Russian Wikipedia page; Sergey Rybakov's field of study and a much fuller career (ATON, Alfa-Bank, A-Investments) were found via Letopis; Ivan Tyryshkin's patronymic and graduation year were found and cross-verified. Honest-gap follow-ups that remained unresolved after one bounded fresh-query attempt each (documented in the round file): Pavel Krupnov's education (only a plausible-but-unverifiable patronymic lead found, an image-only official PDF that could not be independently confirmed, so nothing was added to the JSON); Alexander Chmel's education; Dmitry Panchenko's education years/fields (only an unrelated namesake found); Pavel Sokolov's field of study (two different real namesakes found and explicitly rejected, existing sourced values kept unchanged); the bundled 'RusHydro-related entities' GICS (left null, too heterogeneous to verify each sub-entity in one bounded attempt). No previously-confirmed fact, citation, or note was shortened or deleted; every addition is cited to a source fetched directly during this round.
